items.name: Wayfarer's Oak Staff
items.description: A carved oak staff bound in brass rings. Reliable for sweeping away wild briars and ancient constructs.

items.name: Runeblade Resonance Staff
items.description: Inlaid with Hollow Depths crystal shards that hum with luminous azure resonance on heavy strikes.

items.name: Horizon Galeblade Staff
items.description: Forged with Shattered Expanse skyfeathers and an Aether Core. Unleashes sweeping wind-arcs.

items.name: Woven Traveler's Cloak
items.description: Warm hooded cloak dyed with valley ochre. Grants modest protection against wind and claws.

items.name: Windweaver's Mantle
items.description: Feather-light azure mantle blessed by the Shattered Expanse drafts. Boosts movement and defense.

items.name: Frostcrest Alpine Coat
items.description: Fur-lined highland expedition coat woven to endure the freezing snowstorms of Highland Reach.

items.name: Golden Sunberry
items.description: Sweet amber berries harvested in Verdant Valley and Emerald Wilds.

items.name: Silver River Trout
items.description: Fresh shimmering trout caught along the clear shallows of the Silver River.

items.name: Spiced Sunberry Stew
items.description: Hearty campfire stew that restores vitality and wards off Highland frost.

items.name: Herb-Seared River Trout
items.description: Golden hearth-grilled trout seasoned with wild moonpetal sprigs.

items.name: Honeyed Hearth Flatbread
items.description: Crisp Crossroads flatbread glazed with wildflower honey. Ideal for long climbs and gliding.

items.name: Luminous Spirit Tonic
items.description: Distilled from Moonpetals and resonant crystal dust. Rapidly revives weary Wayfarers.

items.name: Emberbloom Warming Elixir
items.description: Radiant highland brew that completely restores warmth during alpine blizzards.

items.name: Silver Moonpetal
items.description: A dew-lit flower blooming around the Emerald Wilds and ancient streams.

items.name: Ancient Heartwood
items.description: Dense, fragrant timber shed beneath giant forest canopies.

items.name: Resonant Crystal Shard
items.description: A glowing prism splinter humming softly from the Hollow Depths.

items.name: Forgotten Sentinel Core
items.description: A brass-and-stone mechanism salvaged from guardians of the Forgotten Kingdom.

items.name: Azure Sea Glass
items.description: Wave-polished turquoise glass found along the beaches of Azure Coast.

items.name: Drowned Archive Pearl
items.description: Iridescent deep-water pearl recovered by diving into sunken ruins off Azure Coast.

items.name: Highland Frostbloom
items.description: Ice-rimmed starflower that thrives on the snowy ridges of Highland Reach.

items.name: Updraft Skyfeather
items.description: Weightless iridescent plume drifting through the thermal winds of Shattered Expanse.

items.name: Sovereign Aether Core
items.description: Radiant ancient heart reclaimed from mighty guardian bosses across the realm.

items.name: Key of the Unknown Gate
items.description: A harmonic bronze-and-crystal key attuned to the sealed Unknown Gate in the Hidden Frontier.

items.name: Sunken Archive Seal
items.description: A salt-worn bronze tablet from the submerged halls of the Drowned Archive.
